title: Add --version flag to CLI
description: The CLI tool should support a --version (or -v) flag that prints the current version string and exits with code 0. The version string is derived from package.json (name + version), so for this repo it prints 'noteapi v1.0.0'. Acceptance: running the CLI with --version prints '<name> v<version>' read from package.json (currently 'noteapi v1.0.0'), exit code 0, works alongside/independently of other flags; -v behaves identically; no stack trace.

title: [impl] Implement list and read subcommands
description:
Wire the read-only CRUD subcommands into the CLI dispatcher.
Files: src/cli/index.ts (+ a small src/cli/commands/ file if it keeps handlers tidy).
Behaviour: 'list' calls GET /api/notes; supports optional --tag <tag> and --q <query> filters (passed as query params) and prints each note (id + title) to stdout. 'read --id <id>' calls GET /api/notes/:id and prints the full note; missing/invalid id or 404 prints an error to stderr and exits non-zero.

title: [impl] Implement create, update, delete subcommands
description:
Wire the write CRUD subcommands into the CLI dispatcher.
Files: src/cli/index.ts (+ commands file).
Behaviour: 'create --title <t> --content <c>' calls POST /api/notes and prints the created note (with new id). 'update --id <id>' with optional --title/--content calls PUT /api/notes/:id and prints the updated note. 'delete --id <id>' calls DELETE /api/notes/:id and prints a confirmation. Missing required flags or API errors print to stderr and exit non-zero.
Done when: all three subcommands call the correct client helpers, print results to stdout, and exit 0 on success / non-zero on error.
